text:
emily: Dropping an updated mock for the Playground chat bar: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh/playground-chat-bar-v2 — focus here: streaming presentation, stop/regenerate affordances, and the token badge. quick thoughts?
rory: Clean. My immediate concern is the streaming text causing the message row height to grow when tokens render. can we reserve the space with a skeleton row so nothing jumps?
luca: Skeleton is fine. Another approach: render progressive text normally but keep the toolbar height fixed and overlay the token badge (absolute positioned). avoids layout churn.
talia: Overlay works, but watch overlap with long messages on small widths. need an overflow fade and accessible label for the badge.
neil: For the token badge: show live estimate with a subtle pulse (not distracting). Use a leading tilde for estimates (~45). When finalised swap to exact number and remove pulse. Also include a tooltip "Estimated tokens during generation".emily: +1 on tooltip. UX question: stop/regenerate iconography — should stop be a filled square or the word? which has better clarity in a11y tests?
rory: Filled square is a common affordance but screen readers read icons poorly unless we add aria-label. Recommend icon + visible label for mobile, icon-only for desktop with accessible name.
luca: Keyboard flows: want full keyboard parity. Proposed keys: Esc to stop, Shift+R to regenerate, / to focus prompt search. Thoughts?
talia: Esc for stop might conflict with modals. Maybe Ctrl+. for stop? also we need to document conflict matrix.
neil: We should implement a user preference toggle under Settings -> Shortcuts to remap. Start with sensible defaults: Ctrl+. stop, Ctrl+Enter regenerate? (Ctrl+Enter is common for incrementing generation)emily: Copy tweaks: current tooltip "Regenerate" -> "Regenerate response (uses same context)" helps reduce confusion. Also change stop tooltip to "Stop generation (keeps partial text)".
rory: Accessibility: use role="status" for live updates, not aria-live="polite" on interactive controls. status region reads changes without interrupting. Also include `aria-atomic="true"` for counters.
luca: Implementation note: batch token updates to once every 300ms and send telemetry only when value changes by 5 tokens to reduce noise.
talia: On mobile behaviour: token badge should be hidden by default in compact mode (to avoid crowding) and available via a tap to expand toolbar. We'll add a small chevron for expand.
neil: Contrast note: red stop variants fail 4.5:1 at small sizes. Offer an alternative high-contrast palette and expose token for designers in the figma styles.emily: QA can you add tests for: keyboard stop, keyboard regenerate, token badge toggling, prompt drawer open/close with shortcut?
qa-bot: Plan added: tests/playground/toolbar_shortcuts.spec.js with scenarios: open prompt drawer via shortcut, insert quick prompt, start generation, stop via keyboard shortcut, regenerate via shortcut, verify token badge shows ~ estimate then final. Also add accessibility audit for role=status usage.
rory: Also telemetry: add events `playground.toolbar_shown`, `playground.generation_stop_key`, `playground.token_estimate_shown` with properties { mode: "compact|expanded", estimate: true|false, device_type }. include `ui_variant` tag for canary rollout.
luca: For canary let's do 5% to start on web, mobile later. We need a feature flag name. Suggest `playground_toolbar_v2`.
talia: Small microcopy: change button label in compact to "Stop gen" instead of just "Stop" to save space and improve a11y. screen readers will read full label.
neil: Agree. Also add visually-hidden text that announces "Generation running, X tokens estimated" when starting. This helps screen reader users understand token meter presence.emily: Great. Next steps: Luca will prototype overlay + batching; Rory will spec keyboard mappings and conflict matrix; Talia will write mobile breakpoint rules; Neil will provide high-contrast color tokens; QA will land tests; I'll schedule a short usability session with 5 folks next week to validate microcopy and token pulse.
rory: Thanks — dropping a few comments in figma now for precise offsets.
luca: I'll put a short demo build on a feature branch for review.
talia: I'll also add the accessible pattern for the expandable toolbar in the component library doc.
neil: ping me when demo is up, I'll run the contrast checks and screen reader walkthrough.
qa-bot: reminder: add e2e flakeyness guard: waitForStableText before asserting token final value (to avoid CI race).
